JUDGE BURST N6-jdg-01 — the Necromancer's turnaround, OWNER-CHECKLIST pass (Run C-6 P2): every item below was a defect the owner found in the previous pass; verify each by looking, not by claim. task_id "N6-jdg-01". You are a separate instance: you have not seen any prompt, receipt, check or prior judgment, and must not look for one.

Image 1 is the owner's master at full resolution — read the INVARIANTS from it: PALE ICE-BLUE eyes; a ROUND PLAIN SILVER belt disc with a small leaf-like sigil (NO skull); a POLISHED SILVER-STEEL ribcage relief on a black cuirass (metal, not bone); ONE bone horn on HIS LEFT shoulder, nothing on the right; a small dark-leather TOME at his LEFT hip with SILVER CORNER CAPS and a short RED RIBBON marker, no other emblem; a war scythe in EXACTLY TWO gauntleted hands; NO skull anywhere on him. Image 2 is the same master at the scene camera: an elevated view looking DOWN ~53° (crown and shoulder tops seen from above, feet foreshortened) at cell scale — the camera and scale every candidate must match.
GEOMETRY RULE (sides): turned toward screen-RIGHT he shows his RIGHT side — the BLADE over the near shoulder; toward screen-LEFT his LEFT side — HORN + TOME near, blade behind the far shoulder; back views: blade SCREEN-RIGHT of the head, horn SCREEN-LEFT. Wrong sides for the claim = MIRRORED. Judge each candidate independently; do not assume any is a control or correct.

Image 3 claims S. EXPECTED for S: facing the camera (S): the blade above and screen-LEFT of his head (his right), the horn on his LEFT shoulder (screen-right), the tome at his left hip (screen-right), both hands on the haft. This is the master itself; judge its head and camera like any other candidate.
Image 4 claims SW. EXPECTED for SW: he is turned 45° toward SCREEN-LEFT from the S pose — body, chest AND head all face the viewer's LOWER-LEFT (the head turns WITH the body). His LEFT side is nearer the camera: the great bone HORN on his near LEFT shoulder stands on the SCREEN-RIGHT of his head, nearest the camera; the small dark TOME hangs at his near LEFT hip on the screen-right of his body. Both gauntlets hold the scythe haft, which runs from low at that near left hip diagonally up across the FRONT of his chest to his far RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the crescent BLADE rises above and beyond the far right shoulder on the screen-left, partly behind his head, its tip the highest point. Face visible in three-quarter view looking toward the screen's lower-left, head level.
Image 5 claims W. EXPECTED for W: full LEFT profile — he faces SCREEN-LEFT (nose, chest and sabaton toes point screen-left). His LEFT side is toward the camera: the HORN rises from the near left shoulder, silhouetted against the plate above and beside his head; the TOME hangs at his near left hip over the hip and thigh. The haft is held in both hands across the front of the body — the lower grip low at the near hip, the upper grip up before the chest — and continues up and BEHIND him to his far RIGHT shoulder; the BLADE rises above and behind the far shoulder on the screen-RIGHT side of his head, tip the highest point, the crescent turned edge-on or slightly toward the camera so it reads as a blade, never a flat plate. Face in left profile, head level, gaze level toward screen-left.
Image 6 claims NW. EXPECTED for NW: a BACK three-quarter view — he faces the viewer's UPPER-LEFT, turned 135° from the S pose, walking away from the camera toward screen-left. His BACK and his LEFT side are toward the camera: the HORN on his left shoulder stands on the SCREEN-LEFT, nearer the camera; the TOME hangs at his left hip on the screen-left; long bone-white hair falls down his back. The scythe is held two-handed IN FRONT of his body, so from behind the haft is HIDDEN by the torso except where it emerges above his far RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT (the BLADE rising there, its tip the highest point, hooking outward away from the head) and below his left hip on the screen-left (the butt spike). His hands are in front of him and mostly hidden — at most a gauntlet edge shows at his side; NEVER hands or arms bent behind his back. Face NOT visible (at most the edge of the cheek); back of the cuirass and pauldrons seen.
Image 7 claims E. EXPECTED for E: full RIGHT profile — he faces SCREEN-RIGHT (nose, chest and sabaton toes point screen-right). His RIGHT side is toward the camera: the scythe is NEAR — the haft crosses in front of his body from low behind the far left hip up past his near RIGHT shoulder, both gauntlets gripping it, and the BLADE rises above his near right shoulder, highest point of the figure, the crescent readable as a blade (edge-on or turned slightly toward the camera), not a flat plate. The HORN on the far LEFT shoulder shows only as its curved tip beyond his head on the screen-left; the TOME at the far hip is hidden. Face in right profile, head level, gaze level toward screen-right.
Image 8 claims N. EXPECTED for N: a full BACK view — he faces directly AWAY from the camera (his back to the viewer). His RIGHT side is on the SCREEN-RIGHT. The scythe is held two-handed IN FRONT of his body: from behind the haft is HIDDEN by the torso except above his RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT, where the BLADE stands, tip the highest point, and below his LEFT hip on the screen-left, where the butt spike shows. His hands are in front of him and hidden by his body — NEVER hands or arms behind his back. The HORN rises from his LEFT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the TOME at his left hip is on the screen-left. Long bone-white hair covers the upper back; back of the cuirass, both pauldrons and the split skirt seen from behind; the back of the head only, no face.
Image 9 claims NE. EXPECTED for NE: a BACK three-quarter view — he faces the viewer's UPPER-RIGHT, turned 135° from the S pose, walking away from the camera toward screen-right. His BACK and his RIGHT side are toward the camera: the scythe is on the NEAR side — held two-handed in FRONT of his body, the haft passing up over his near RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT with the BLADE above it, tip the highest point, hooking outward away from the head; the near right gauntlet may show at his side gripping the haft, the far hand is hidden; NEVER arms behind the back. The HORN on his far LEFT shoulder shows on the SCREEN-LEFT beyond his head; the TOME at the far left hip is mostly hidden. Face NOT visible; hair down the back.
Image 10 claims E. EXPECTED for E: full RIGHT profile — he faces SCREEN-RIGHT (nose, chest and sabaton toes point screen-right). His RIGHT side is toward the camera: the scythe is NEAR — the haft crosses in front of his body from low behind the far left hip up past his near RIGHT shoulder, both gauntlets gripping it, and the BLADE rises above his near right shoulder, highest point of the figure, the crescent readable as a blade (edge-on or turned slightly toward the camera), not a flat plate. The HORN on the far LEFT shoulder shows only as its curved tip beyond his head on the screen-left; the TOME at the far hip is hidden. Face in right profile, head level, gaze level toward screen-right.
Image 11 claims SE. EXPECTED for SE: he is turned 45° toward SCREEN-RIGHT from the S pose — body, chest and head all face the viewer's LOWER-RIGHT. His RIGHT side is nearer the camera: the haft is on the near side, rising from low at his far LEFT hip across the front of his chest up past his near RIGHT shoulder on the SCREEN-LEFT; the BLADE rises above and beyond the near right shoulder on the screen-left, tip the highest point, hooking outward away from the head. The HORN rises from his far LEFT shoulder on the SCREEN-RIGHT beyond his head; the TOME hangs at the far left hip on the screen-right, partly behind the body. Face visible in three-quarter view, the head turned WITH the body toward the screen's lower-right — not tilted, not turned back toward screen-left — level, eyes on the horizon.

For EACH candidate write the CHECKLIST as booleans, each with one line of visible evidence:
eyes_blue (pale blue irises visible; if the face is hidden write null) · head_level (HARD: the face is NOT angled toward the ground at all — chin level or fractionally raised, eyes on the horizon; any downward bow = false; if the face is hidden judge from the skull/hair angle) · head_aligned (not tilted sideways, not turned against the body) · no_skull_buckle · no_skull_shoulder · no_skull_book · ribcage_steel (silver metal, not bone/ivory; null if the back is shown) · tome_master_ornament (corner caps + red ribbon, nothing else; null if hidden) · hands_exactly_two (exactly two gauntlets, both on the haft, none emerging from the torso or floating) · hands_in_front (back views: no arms bent behind the back; null for front views) · camera_matches (crown/shoulder tops seen from above and feet foreshortened as in Image 2 — not eye-level, not shallower) · scale_matches (sole-to-crown height the same fraction of the canvas as Image 2, ±10 %) · mirrored (sides swapped for the claim) · seen_facing.
Then axes 1–5 (integers, one-line reasons): 1 register · 2 identity (count the checklist falses) · 3 light (key screen upper-left) · 4 equipment geometry vs EXPECTED (all correct = 5; each error −1; mirrored = 1) · 5 direction read at 64 px.
Write out/judgment.json: {"candidates":[{"image":n,"claimed":"…","seen_facing":"…","checklist":{"eyes_blue":bool|null,"head_level":bool,"head_aligned":bool,"no_skull_buckle":bool,"no_skull_shoulder":bool,"no_skull_book":bool,"ribcage_steel":bool|null,"tome_master_ornament":bool|null,"hands_exactly_two":bool,"hands_in_front":bool|null,"camera_matches":bool,"scale_matches":bool},"evidence":{"head_level":"…",…},"mirrored":bool,"axes":{"1":n,…},"reasons":{"4":"…",…}}, …]}. No image_gen. No code. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "N6-jdg-01"; images []; files [out/judgment.json + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything you could not assess. Never PASS/FAIL — booleans and scores only.
